about_the_game:
WELCOME WENDY

Meet Wendy — a little vixen with dirty thoughts and big ambitions. Her swimsuit is barely holding on: damp fabric clings to her skin, playful knots... Oops, the top just slipped off!

This girl loves being naughty — she giggles when she's spanked and bites her lips when things don't go her way. Wendy adores being given orders, but still wiggles her hips and teases with her sharp tongue, driving everyone crazy with her antics. She pulls off the innocent act like a pro, pretending to be naïve and clueless, but deep down, this beauty has already tasted the thrill of grown-up games.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

Add Wendy to your collection — and this cutie will do whatever your heart desires. You can change your mascot at any time by opening your profile in the game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
